notes.title: OFFICIAL PUBLISHER ANNOUNCEMENT
notes.notes:
As a two-person dev team, building this game has been a massive challenge but also an incredibly rewarding journey. Having a publisher help support us in getting it out into the world has allowed us to fully focus on one thing: making the best game we possibly can.


For those of you who may not know, working with a game publishing platform like indie.io greatly helps indie developers focus on game development while they handle all the behind-the-scenes magic. From helping manage store pages to crafting marketing campaigns and even helping the game shine at both digital and live events, indie.io helps in all the aspects that indie developers often struggle with alone.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45628754/59999ef56e456dc7d0d91102415d8565a622b492.png[/img]
  

We can’t wait to show you all the awesome stuff we’ve got coming! Don’t forget to wishlist the game and follow us on Twitter to stay up to date.
